criteria.description: Lecture — lecture10.ipynb: complete the shared dummy-data insert, two updates, delete, and three query exercises, with executed code and outputs. This is one 30-point criterion; no separate lecture AI Use or overall Summary.

Lab Questions — lab10.ipynb: Q1–Q4, 10 pts each. Include query, executable Python, required table/chart output, and brief findings in Markdown. Read student's existing lab8.tweet_collection without changing it. No separate overall Summary.

AI Use — lab10.ipynb after Q4: 3–4 sentences on approved tools (MongoDB AI, Colab Gemini), how they helped, a check/limitation, and privacy risk. Unapproved AI use yields 0 for the assignment; repeated violations reported to Honor Council.

Submission & Source Access: assigned GitHub root URL and working MongoDB URI in private Canvas. lecture10.ipynb and lab10.ipynb at repo root on main with outputs. Credential exposure is a one-time 20-pt deduction floored at zero (not double-deducted).
